downgraded.text: In a Servian story a vila from the hill, hearing a husband boast that his wife was fairer than the white vila, demanded to see her and admitted she was three times as beautiful.
downgraded.to_text: In a Servian story a husband boasted that his wife was more beautiful than the white vila; the vila from the hill overheard and demanded to see her, and the wife was three times as beautiful as the vila.
downgraded.reason: Ralston p.147 has the narrator state that the wife was three times as beautiful; the vila does not 'admit' it in those words, she says only that the vaunt is no great one. Narrowed to the page's telling.

downgraded.text: In a Servian song the vila from the hill says the hill bore her, swaddled her in green leaves, the morning dew nourished her and the hill breeze rocked her.
downgraded.to_text: In a Servian story the vila from the hill says the hill itself bore her and swaddled her in green leaves, the morning dew nourished her and the breeze from the hill rocked her.
downgraded.reason: Ralston p.147 introduces the passage as 'says a story', not a song; 'song' replaced with 'story'.

grade_rationale.text: Machal records the vila among Serbs, Bulgarians, Slovaks, Poles and Slovenians, and says the Vila is mentioned in the ancient written traditions of the Russians.

Machal also says the Vila is mentioned in the ancient written traditions of the Czechs, a seventh people; the Czechs row was restored after verify because the people-table form "Czechs" was added after verify (phase 4b-peoples-3). The grade is unchanged.
Karadzic's dictionary describes the Serbian vila's dwelling, dress, hair and punishments independently of Machal.
Afanasyev records the Bulgarian samovila and samodiva and the Serbian vily turning into swans.
Ralston independently describes the Servian Vilas and a Bulgarian song of a fountain-guarding Vila, without citing Afanasyev on those passages.
Ralston's story of the vila from the hill is quoted from Vuk Karadjich by Buslaef, so on that passage he is not independent of Karadzic and is counted once with him.
